data.rationale: The proposal follows the same npm, GitHub repo, Releases and Notes procedure with the right single parameter and the same data fields, but it leaves out two things: closing the GitHub tab or going Back, and the exact format of the note text. It also collects stars and open issues on the Releases page instead of the repo page, which is minor because those counts show in the repo header on both pages.
